title: 鐵路平交道警報聯動
summary: 本課聚焦平交道警示時序道路清空與界面整合。從道路使用者反應距離建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把路口回堵累積與區段偵測有效性連成可驗證的介面，最後以路鐵整合情境矩陣整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies crossing-warning timing road clearance and interface integration. Start with road-user reaction distance to define physical or information boundaries, connect queue spillback toward the crossing with validity of section detection as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through road–rail integration scenario matrix. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究道路使用者反應距離。原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。敏感度只改 reaction=2.5 至 2.75 s，輸出變為 44 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究道路車輛停止距離：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元以假想道路接近速度分析察覺到反應的移動距離，保留不同視線與能力群體的差異。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate road-user reaction distance. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. For sensitivity, change only reaction=2.5 to 2.75 s; the output becomes 44 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate stopping distance of road vehicles: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Use an assumed road-approach speed to analyse travel between detection and response, retaining differences in visibility and user capability. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 道路使用者反應距離與道路車輛停止距離
stages.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance & Stopping distance of road vehicles
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「道路使用者反應距離」與「道路車輛停止距離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Road-user reaction distance" and "Stopping distance of road vehicles": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 道路使用者反應距離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「道路使用者反應距離」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Road-user reaction distance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元以假想道路接近速度分析察覺到反應的移動距離，保留不同視線與能力群體的差異。反應期間移動距離由速度乘反應時間決定，這段距離在任何制動能力發揮前已經消耗。察覺、理解與動作不是同一時刻，介面可讀性和預期程度會改變反應；把受訓受試者的最佳表現當作所有人的固定值會低估需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「道路使用者反應距離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use an assumed road-approach speed to analyse travel between detection and response, retaining differences in visibility and user capability. Distance during reaction is speed times reaction time and is consumed before braking can take effect. Detection, interpretation and action are separate moments influenced by readability and expectation. The best performance of a trained participant is not a fixed value applicable to everyone. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Road-user reaction distance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「制動性能很好就可以完全忽略人員反應期間的距離」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 道路使用者反應距離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Road-user reaction distance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「道路使用者反應距離」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Road-user reaction distance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：接近速度 v=16 m/s；假想反應時間 reaction=2.5 s。公式 y=v*reaction，代入得 y=40 m。邊界：等速反應距離的原創假設，不是道路或鐵道的正式設計視距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: approach speed v=16 m/s; assumed reaction time reaction=2.5 s. Formula y=v*reaction gives y=40 m. Boundary: Constant-speed reaction-distance teaching assumption, not an official road or railway sight-distance requirement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use safe desktop replay to separate detection and action times, reporting distributions and uncertainty rather than only the fastest attempt.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Road-user reaction distance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以安全桌面重播分別量察覺與動作時間，呈現分布與不確定度，而非只報最快一次。以「道路使用者反應距離」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 事先告知事件時刻會使反應異常快速，視線遮蔽則可能讓訊號亮起到被察覺之間增加延誤。回到「道路使用者反應距離」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 本單元以低速穿越距離和等待觀察清空時間，分開長車尾端離開與車頭通過的時刻。道路車輛清空時間從開始等待到車尾完全離開衝突區計算，距離必須包含車長而不能只看車頭的位置。定速度估算只展示等待與移動兩部分，長車起步、轉彎和下游阻塞可能改變速度；鄰近號誌的放行並不保證車尾已有足夠可用空間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定車速與固定起步等待的桌面教學模型，未含加速、坡度、轉彎或現場警示設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車輛清空所需時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rear-end clearance travel distance=30 m; assumed constant vehicle speed speed=2 m/s; startup waiting wait=4 s. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: Track vehicle arrival and departure rates directly at the adjacent junction, showing how insufficient downstream service accumulates vehicles while treating physical queue length as a separate geometric constraint. New road-queue occupancy is the difference between arrival and departure rates times duration, measured over one lane group. This is a continuous approximation to expected flow while actual vehicles are discrete events. Whether spillback reaches a crossing also depends on vehicle lengths, gaps and storage distance; average service rate alone cannot prove that the conflict area remains clear. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Increment under fixed mean flows with a persistent queue, excluding initial occupancy, storage length and discrete arrivals. knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: rated capacity capacity=80 Ah; nominal voltage voltage=24 V; usable fraction fraction=0.7 1; constant load load=350 W. Formula y=capacity*voltage*fraction/load gives y=3.84 h. Boundary: Constant-voltage constant-load approximation; nonlinear discharge and temperature effects are excluded.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「警示備援電源」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backup energy for warnings” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測完整負載曲線與最低端電壓，分別核對連續能量及啟動瞬間壓降。以「警示備援電源」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the load profile and minimum terminal voltage, checking continuous energy and startup sag separately. For backup energy for warnings, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Explain the causal direction for backup energy for warnings, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fault causes for warning failure" and "Road–rail integration scenario matrix": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 警示失效原因樹：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fault causes for warning failure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「警示失效原因樹」如何影響鐵路平交道警報聯動的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fault causes for warning failure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Railway grade-crossing warning coordination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將供電、通訊和顯示器異常分開列入原因樹，要求每個候選原因有可區分的量測。只要任一支路失效就產生頂事件時，需計算聯集而不是把兩機率相乘。獨立假設允許扣掉交集的乘積，若共享電源、環境或軟體則交集另有結構；事件樹和失效樹必須保持同一任務時間。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：兩事件獨立且機率屬同一任務期間，並非每小時危險失效率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「警示失效原因樹」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separate supply, communication and display faults in a cause tree, requiring discriminating measurements for each candidate cause. When either branch can trigger the top event, the relevant probability is a union rather than a product. Independence permits the intersection to be written as a product; shared power, environment or software changes that intersection. Event and fault trees must use the same mission duration. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Two independent events over one mission interval, not a dangerous-failure rate per hour. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fault causes for warning failure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：事件一機率 p1=0.001 1；事件二機率 p2=0.002 1。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If either branch failure is sufficient, total failure probability equals their product." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
